unit.title: Use PXL with evidence gating for mature programmes

claim.text: The source describes PXL as replacing subjective scores with about 10-14 binary or scaled criteria tied to evidence, weighted, mostly yes/no, cutting scoring subjectivity; best for mature programmes; slowest.
claim.quote: PXL (Peep Laja / CXL): replaces subjective scores with about 10-14 binary or scaled criteria tied to evidence: is the change above the fold, is it noticeable within 5 seconds, is it on a high-traffic page, is it backed by heatmaps/user testing/surveys/analytics, how hard to build. Weighted, mostly yes/no, which cuts scoring subjectivity. Best for mature programmes. Slowest.
